Launched Dec 21, 2021 with a $5M seed (BusinessWire/Femtech Insider) from MaC VC, Pear Accelerator, Long Journey, Ulu, Graph Ventures and angels. Forbes calls it combined pre-seed and seed money, with MaC VC as lead. Sportico (Mar 2026) says Sequel has raised over $8M (per Forbes, June 2025), with investors including RRE Ventures, and that Tipt Ventures invested in late 2025 (amount undisclosed); an official Series A is planned. amount_raised = the 'over $8M' reported total, so treat it as a lower bound.
